content: We train NMT with RAT to achieve better query translations. We improve a recently proposed NMT baseline, Transformer, that achieves state-of-the-art results for sentence pairs in some languages BIBREF8 . We discuss Transformer, RAT, and our multi-task learning architecture that achieves balanced translation.
